title: Interdisciplinary Instruction Contact
before:
Kathy Bertini
Interdisciplinary Instruction Team Coordinator

Supports the following areas:

  • Creating integrated professional learning experiences that connect subjects, strengthen literacy, numeracy, civics, and STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics), and bridge real-world relevance with academic rigor.
  • Designing student-centered, interest-driven instruction aligned with the Whole Student Approach to build engagement, agency, and future readiness.
  • Programming inclusive, interdisciplinary, and data-informed strategies that raise achievement and re-engage learners.
  • Liaising between the Maine DOE and the Maine Curriculum Leaders Association (MCLA) and Maine Principals’ Association (MPA), ensuring alignment, communication, and collaboration across statewide initiatives.

notes: 490 words with no section headers at all — the biggest single improvement available here.

decisions.label: Write the email addresses the same way
decisions.why: 1 address is shown in whatever case it was typed in. The house form capitalises each name and leaves a middle initial in lower case — Michele.R.Mailhot@maine.gov → Michele.r.Mailhot@maine.gov. Only the first letter of each part changes, so a name that spells itself LaBreck keeps doing so.

decisions.label: Make a loose address look like an address
decisions.why: 6 email addresses sit in the body of this page rather than in a contact block, drawn exactly like every other link — so the one that opens a mail window looks the same as the ones that go to web pages. The chip carries the same envelope the banner's contact link uses. The address itself does not change.

decisions.label: Retire the old banner graphic
decisions.why: It repeats the page title in picture form, which the new banner already does in type.

decisions.label: Let a portrait photograph keep its shape
decisions.why: 6 card pictures are taller than they are wide — headshots, mostly — and every card image is cropped to 16:9, so most of the person is thrown away to make a landscape strip. Measured from the files: these are 500x667 rendered into 293x165. Marked as portrait, the card gives them a shape they fit and the picture runs up the card instead. The file does not change.
